plugins.name: pp-zcode
plugins.description: Pocock × PStack in one plugin: Matt Pocock's requirements skills (grilling / to-spec / to-tickets and their support skills) ship bundled, implement-spec bridges a spec or ticket set to the poteto-mode execution engine (a zcode port of pstack), and pipeline-accept gates delivery on evidence. Invoke every skill by its qualified pp-zcode:<name> so a user-level install of the same skill cannot shadow it.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Pocock 需求技能（grilling / to-spec / to-tickets 及配套技能）随插件打包，implement-spec 把 spec/工单交接给 poteto-mode 执行引擎（pstack 移植版），pipeline-accept 凭证据验收；所有技能以 pp-zcode:<name> 限定名调用，避免被用户级同名技能遮蔽
